Experience: Minimum three (03) years of relevant experience in hospital administration, healthcare management or hospital operations | Other conditions: | Proficiency in English, computer literacy and knowledge of applicable Government rules, legislation, policies and healthcare regulations All qualifications must be from a university / college recognized by Govt. of India Candidates holding Domicile Certificate of Daman & Diu will be given preference | Desirable: | Training and experience in the implementation of JCI/NABH/NQAS accreditation or certification requirements in recognized hospitals Two letters of recommendation from previously employed institutions

how_to_apply: Get the application in the prescribed format from the website www.ddd.gov.in (the format is also printed with this notice).
Affix a latest photograph, fill in the form and sign it; unsigned applications will be rejected.
Attach one set of self-attested photocopies of education qualification, registration certificate, experience certificate and other relevant documents.
Send it to the Member Secretary (GB), Rogi Kalyan Samiti, Govt. Hospital, Daman Office of the Medical Superintendent, NAMO. Hospital, Daman, Nani Daman – 396210.
The application may also be sent by email to [email protected].
The application should reach on or before 16/11/2026 by 12:00 PM.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview Application deviating from prescribed format and required criteria will be summarily rejected Member Secretary may terminate the selection process without assigning a reason Contact No. 0260 – 2254266 / 2254965

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAMO Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Get the application in the prescribed format from the website www.ddd.gov.in (the format is also printed with this notice). Affix a latest photograph, fill in the form and sign it; unsigned applications will be rejected. Attach one set of self-attested photocopies of education qualification, registration certificate, experience certificate and other relevant documents. Send it to the Member Secretary (GB), Rogi Kalyan Samiti, Govt. Hospital, Daman Office of the Medical Superintendent, NAMO. Hospital, Daman, Nani Daman – 396210. The application may also be sent by email to [email protected] . The application should reach on or before 16/11/2026 by 12:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview Application deviating from prescribed format and required criteria will be summarily rejected Member Secretary may terminate the selection process without assigning a reason Contact No. 0260 – 2254266 / 2254965

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NAMO Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NAMO Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Hospital Manager.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NAMO Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format on website www.ddd.gov.in; also printed on pages 2-3 of this notice) and send it to Member Secretary (GB), Rogi Kalyan Samiti, Govt. Hospital, Daman Office of the Medical Superintendent, NAMO. Hospital, Daman, Nani Daman – 396210, by post or email, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 50,000 per month consolidated, plus performance-based incentive of up to Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS / BDS graduate with a Master's degree in Hospital Administration / MPH in Public Health Management; minimum three (03) years of relevant experience in hospital administration, healthcare management or hospital operations; proficiency in English, computer literacy and knowledge of applicable Government rules, legislation, policies and healthcare regulations.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Proficiency in English, computer literacy and knowledge of applicable Government rules, legislation, policies and healthcare regulations. All qualifications must be from a university / college recognized by Govt. of India. Candidates holding Domicile Certificate of Daman & Diu will be given preference.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Person who has been previously terminated from any Government Organization shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Only eligible candidates will be called for interview. Selection committee reserves the right to relax the criteria if otherwise found fit.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Short-Term Contract (STC) basis for a period of six months under Rogi Kalyan Samiti, Government Hospital, Daman.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: NAMO Hospital, Daman.
